independent_execution.focused_tests: 19 passed in 50.41s: AEON adapter, SSL contract and campaign integration suites
independent_execution.ruff: All reviewed AEON campaign, loader, model and focused test files passed

findings: The real campaign reader is restricted to TRAIN and validation source dates and cannot request CAL or TEST partitions.
All families use the same hash-bound 24-by-4 past-only cohort and 1/3/6 source-interval targets; normalizers, residuals, conventional models and SSL pretraining fit on TRAIN only.
Histogram gradient boosting uses fifteen TRAIN-fitted quantile heads, one per horizon and quantile, followed by the frozen monotone rearrangement.
Direct, EMA-JEPA and shared-SIGReg inference encoders and quantile heads have matched width, depth and output contracts.
EMA and shared-SIGReg use the reviewed mode-specific gradient contracts and held-out last-six-of-24 past target view.
Random-encoder and shuffled-target controls are present for both modes; shuffled pairs remain inside TRAIN and are separated by at least 24 source intervals.
Random-encoder controls match the 1500-update supervised decoder budget and explicitly retain the unavoidable unequal total learned-update budget caused by zero pretraining.
Final-pretrain TRAIN-only target variance, effective-rank and predictor-scale diagnostics are persisted so collapse remains visible.

Each slot saves row-level validation predictions, metrics, hashed model/checkpoint artifacts and resource records; completed-slot resume verifies hashes and final selection cannot choose an intermediate checkpoint.
approval_scope: Execute the exact hash-bound 17-slot AEON TRAIN/validation development campaign locally with one training process and preserve all completed and failed slots.
conditions: Any code, config, protocol, source, split-review or cohort-hash change invalidates this approval.
Do not omit failed slots, rerun seeds because of validation outcomes or select intermediate validation checkpoints.
Single-seed controls provide bounded diagnostic attribution only.
Perform an independent post-run artifact, metric, checkpoint and collapse review before any CAL/TEST freeze.
Do not access calibration or retrospective test acoustic outcomes under this approval.
known_limitations: The reviewer had already inspected the earlier first-development validation result; this campaign is development and is not a sealed evaluation.
Source clock timezone, exact raw/ECS/certificate binding and absolute field-calibration lineage remain unresolved.
The target is source-reported conditioned Sv from one deployment; no SOTA, biomass, species, causal-control or operational-generalization claim is authorized.
